name: kingshot-tools
description: Research Kingshot events, generate reproducible event-pack CP reports, query packs, and calculate CP value.

interface.shortDescription: Research events and generate reproducible pack CP reports.
interface.longDescription: Research Kingshot event rules, gameplay, milestones, schedules, and strategies; verify the player's current server progression, purchased packs, remaining resources, pack contents, and rewards; then generate reproducible Markdown reports whose primary recommendations use marginal CP from the no-additional-purchase baseline.
defaultPrompt: 查詢 Kingshot 活動的玩法、計分、里程碑與時程。
先確認伺服器進度、已購禮包、剩餘資源與獎品內容，再以不加購基準為 Kingshot 活動產生邊際 CP 報告。
查詢 Kingshot 禮包的價格與內容。
計算這個 Kingshot 禮包的 CP 值。
